passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: New 15-2401.01 opens ESA eligibility to any resident eligible for public preschool-disability, kindergarten, or grades 1-12, matching rung 5's universal clause.
Bill status page lists Kavanagh as a co-sponsor of HB2853; this was during his House service, before his Senate term beginning 2023-01-02.
House Third Reading vote shows Kavanagh voting Y on HB2853, a House floor vote cast before his current Senate term began 2023-01-02.

rows.reasoning: All three HB2853 passages document Kavanagh's co-sponsorship and Yea vote on the 2022 universal ESA expansion, whose enacted text opens ESA eligibility to any resident eligible for public preschool-disability, kindergarten, or grades 1-12, matching rung 5's universal, any-school clause. But the sponsorship and the House Third Reading vote both occurred in 2022 while Kavanagh served in the Arizona House, before his current State Senate term beginning 2023-01-02; per V5, a record from an earlier office is valid for that office only, so none of this evidence can establish the chair for this Senate row.
